article.story: TAMPA, Fla. -- — Sonny Wilson's 22 points helped South Florida defeat Tennessee State 98-71 on Tuesday. Wilson added five rebounds, six assists, and four steals for the Bulls (3-2). Garrett Johnson scored 17 points while shooting 7 for 14, including 3 for 7 from beyond the arc, and added nine rebounds. Chris Davis Jr. shot 4 for 7 (3 for 4 from 3-point range) and 5 of 5 from the free-throw line to finish with 16 points. Arterio Morris led the way for the Tigers (2-3) with 17 points and two steals. Aaron Bradshaw added 14 points, 10 rebounds and three blocks for Tennessee State. Ty-Laur Johnson also had 13 points, seven rebounds and two steals. South Florida led 42-38 at halftime, with Wilson racking up 13 points. South Florida extended its lead to 64-41 during the second half, fueled by a 17-0 scoring run. Johnson scored 12 points in the second half. Up next South Florida's next game is Saturday against George Mason on the road. Tennessee State visits Oklahoma State on Sunday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
